notes: Mobile Harness Code — independent fork of Mobile Harness. New: Phone Control (Developer Tools) adds a strict, opt-in privileged shell layer — Shizuku (shell/root through the Shizuku service), Wireless ADB (detected; SPAKE2 pairing marked not-implemented) and root via the device su binary — with a fail-closed policy (opt-in -> available -> authorized -> level -> sanitized command), bounded output and timeouts, a no-secrets event log, and a test command. libsu (JitPack-hosted) and any LGPL/GPL code are deliberately excluded; the Shizuku API is MIT. Existing tools are untouched: providers + AI router/fallback, local model (Ollama), MCP client, RAG, SSH client/tunnel/TOFU/PTY terminal, in-app update, Telegram bot, multimodal Sidekick, Material 3 dynamic color, Eco Mode, Developer Tools, Share & Invite. This APK is SIGNED (V1+V2+V3); install mobile-harness-online.apk.
